note_text: Don't watch the whole market into CPI tomorrow. Watch AMZN. It closed at 244 on the floor of a falling channel, price below the entire EMA stack. One chart tells you everything.
AMZN scan, straight off the bars: ADX 27.5 with -DI 36.9 over +DI 14.2, MACD hist -3.68, RSI 36, volume 1.9x average. Bears own the tape into the print. Nobody posts the ugly read.
A failed-rally reversal on heavy volume beats one on light volume. AMZN opened 247.68, tagged 250.43, got dumped to 237, closed red at 244 on 1.9x volume. That's a fight the sellers won.

A convergence read isn't one indicator. It's N independent datasets agreeing: technicals, institutional flow, options premium, short interest. AMZN had four nodding the same way into CPI. That's a setup, not an opinion.

I posted twice in one day for the first time, because some of you couldn't watch the tape into CPI and I'd rather you have the levels than a hot take. 237 breaks it, 243 holds it, 250 kills the bear case. Prepare, don't predict.
